blocks.x: I’d just like to state this is tape number two, Jazz Oral History Program interview with Roy Haynes in his home in Long Island. This is May 15th, 1994.

So the ’60s, that’s yet another period. You talked about the feeling of the ’40s, the ’50s. You had quite a varied career, but pretty much centered with your tenure with Sarah Vaughan. In the ’60s you seem to be now – you’re working with Trane . . .
The ’60s, it was a lot of weird, weird stuff happening in the ’60s, you know that.
The civil rights movement and the war.
